messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Replies to your CPSE.1 and property enquiries attached. Two points to flag: there is an outstanding ground-floor rent review (Meridian) due 25 March, and a service-charge query from Carrington Wealth on the 2024 reconciliation (c.£6,800). Both are noted in the replies.

Zoe
